thread:
Maya: Quick sync — EU GPU queue spiked around 03:10 UTC, autoscaler lagged and we had ~90 pending pods for ~6m. Anyone else see the same?
Sam: yup saw it, pending peaked at ~120. Scale-up started but cloud quota hits slowed node creation in eu-west-1.
Jia: I pulled kube-apiserver logs — we hit 429 on node-creation calls and image pulls had repeated timeouts behind our NAT gateway.
Priya: That explains the bootstrap delay. Thinking: introduce a "micro-burst" fast-path that prefers ephemeral preemptible workers + parallel bootstrap. Tradeoff is cost volatility. :thinking: 
Oliver: We need guardrails. Finance will 👎 on unbounded ephemeral usage. Suggest classifier to detect burst vs sustained demand and switch policies instead of single autoscaler thresholds.
Sam: Agree. For bursts: short window, higher max_ephemeral_frac, lower cool-down so we can scale down quickly. For sustained: higher target util, slower churn.
Maya: Can we express this in config and try in staging? Example config sketch: 
```yaml
autoscaler:
  burst_mode:
    enabled: true
    short_window_sec: 120
    max_ephemeral_frac: 0.25
    cooldown_sec: 60
  steady_mode:
    target_gpu_util: 0.7
    min_replicas: 8
    cooldown_sec: 900
```
Jia: Also we should add health checks for bootstrap path: image-pull latency, kubelet registration time. Those drove the 6m delay.
autoscaler-bot: Scaling event 2024-06-25T03:14:27Z: requested=40 nodes, granted=30, denied=10 (quota). Bootstraps still in progress: 22.
Priya: Another lever: fall back to a smaller model variant for burst requests to reduce GPU-hours while waiting for nodes — routing policy do the heavy lifting. We tested dynamic-routing in perf lab with ~30% cost saving but slightly higher latency. :rocket: 
Sam: We should implement a canary: bursts -> fallback model + ephemeral nodes. If fallback reduces QPS backlog within 2m, don’t provision extra reserved nodes.
Oliver: Also need a headroom credit per region (e.g., 200 GPU-hours/week) so tiny bursts don't need quota requests every time. Track consumption and alert when credit < 25%.
Maya: Ops checklist: Priya to run micro-burst lab with image caching baked in; Sam to open PR for classifier + config; Jia to collect bootstrap + NAT gateway metrics; Oliver to prepare region quota request template for cloud.
Priya: I'll also simulate NAT slowdown to confirm behavior. ETA for lab run: EOD Friday.
Sam: I'll draft the PR with gating flags so we can A/B in staging first.
Jia: I'll attach logs and a short timing histogram once I finish vetting — will post here.
Oliver: Finance note — if ephemeral usage would exceed $X/month we need a pre-approved escalation path. I'll sync with finance after the canary.
Maya: Great — let's not change production autopilot until staging canary looks good. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
